Name: Wilting Smite
Description: As part of casting this spell, you must expend two Hit Dice or the spell automatically fails. If you do, the next time you hit a creature with a melee weapon attack during this spell's duration, blood flows over your weapon, then desiccates into black spores falling onto the attack's target. The attack deals extra necrotic damage equal to the total rolled on the Hit Dice expended to cast this spell. Additionally, the creature loses all damage resistances it has until the start of your next turn.
